sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion at this exact site
sites.functional_impact_measured: Surface expression of FLAG-tagged WT and Alzheimer's-associated mutant EPHA1 confirmed in HEK293 cells; functional properties of the receptor studied using the tagged constructs as the experimental system.
sites.rationale: The paper clones EPHA1 residues A25–D976 downstream of a preprotrypsin leader and FLAG tag in pFLAG-CMV3; the preprotrypsin leader replaces the native signal peptide (SP residues 1–25) and is cleaved co-translationally, leaving the FLAG tag exposed on the extracellular face before A25. In canonical UniProt numbering, A25 is the last SP residue and K26 is the mature N-terminus, so insert_after_residue = 25 (between A25 and K26) correctly represents the junction. Python verification confirms res(25) = A and res(26) = K. The tag is 522 residues from the TM boundary (residue 548), satisfying all distance constraints. Full-length human EPHA1 (residues A25–D976) was cloned into pFLAG-CMV3 in frame with a preprotrypsin leader and N-terminal FLAG tag, generating a surface-expressed receptor in transiently transfected HEK293 cells. The construct explicitly names A25 as the first EPHA1 residue after the FLAG tag, placing the junction at the SP/mature-protein boundary (after canonical residue 25, before K26).

sources.claim: A cDNA encoding human EPHA1 residues A25-D976 (GenBank accession number BC130291 ) was cloned between the NotI and BglII sites of pFLAG-CMV3 (E6783, Sigma), in frame with the preprotrypsin leader and the Flag tag to generate the pFLAG-CMV3-EPHA1 construct encoding full-length EPHA1 with an N-terminal Flag tag.

literature_notes: Ledger lines L3–L6 all describe a C-terminal V5/His tag on full-length EphA1 (pcDNA5-V5-His vector). The C-terminus of EPHA1 is residue D976, which lies within the intracellular kinase domain (IC span 569–976). This tag is therefore on the cytoplasmic face and does not qualify as a surface tag site; it is recorded in other_positions. No ledger line supports any internal extracellular loop insertion for EPHA1. L1 and L2 both ground the same N-terminal FLAG site; L1 is used as the primary supporting clip because it explicitly names the construct junction (A25–D976 + preprotrypsin leader + FLAG). L2 corroborates surface expression and functional use of the same construct.

literature_other_positions.note: Full-length EphA1 was tagged at the carboxy terminus (D976) with a V5/His tag for imaging and biochemical analyses; the C-terminus is intracellular (IC domain 569–976), so this tag faces the cytoplasm, not the cell surface.
